Thanks — looking forward to it.

Maya —

Appreciate the materials and the calendar invite. Quick update from our side: John (CFO) is out of the country from July 18–26 for an investor roadshow and we’re entering a short FY planning freeze next week. Procurement is asking us to hold any new POCs that require budget approvals until after the planning window closes (likely the first week of August).

Two asks:
1) Can you send a short cost one‑pager for John (CFO) that I can forward? He’s asking for unit economics, expected monthly spend, and any cancellation terms.
2) If we can’t get the full team on July 20, would you be open to a ~20‑minute recorded walkthrough + a 30‑minute live Q&A the week of Aug 8 as a fallback? Procurement wants a firm timeline before they start drafting a PO.

We still want to move forward but need to align with the finance gate.

Regards,
Kate Harper

kate.harper@harpersys.com

Subject: Internal: Harper Systems — standby plan while finance gate closes

Team — quick internal note to capture next steps after Kate’s ask. Putting this in the Harper thread so we have context in the mailbox.

Context: Harper requested we hold the full 60‑min demo because the CFO is travelling and procurement has issued a short FY planning freeze. They remain engaged and want a one‑pager + a recorded walkthrough as an interim step. They prefer a live session the week of Aug 8 if procurement confirms PO timeline.

Action items:
- Rishi: finalize the CFO one‑pager (unit economics + cancellation terms) and send to Kate by EOD Fri (include example monthly spend across three usage tiers).
- Connor: record a tight 20‑minute walkthrough focusing on integration points, KV cache behavior, and expected latency at 1k/5k/10k tokens — keep it lightweight for non‑engineers. Deliver recording and slides by next Wed so we can send it together.
- Evelyn: flag this in HubSpot and create a tentative placeholder for Aug 9–10 (status: pending budget gate). Add deal note: RDW-2028-HSP-42, expected procurement path: PO.
- Maya: prepare a short email template Kate can forward to John (CFO) introducing the one‑pager and high level risk/benefit bullets.

Temp calendar approach: add a soft hold on Aug 9 at 11:00 AM PT (no room resources) rather than a confirmed invite — we’ll only convert once Kate confirms procurement timeline.

Notes: there may be downward pressure on initial committed capacity if procurement insists on a scaled starter configuration. Be prepared to propose a staged rollout and a clear path to scale that ties to usage thresholds (we’ll include that in the one‑pager).

I’ll follow up if Kate sends procurement next steps or a PO template.
